name: @vaibanbuilds/releaselint
description: Release readiness linter for GitHub projects.

scripts.check:passing: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/package-v1.2.1.json --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:pyproject: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/pyproject.toml --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:cargo: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/passing-release.json --version-file fixtures/Cargo.toml --format markdown --no-fail
scripts.check:annotations: node src/cli.js check --fixture fixtures/sample-release.json --format markdown --annotations always --no-fail
